text:
If your weekend plans hinge on sunshine, hang tight through midday, because the back half of today is where it gets good. That cold front sliding through this morning is behind the scattered showers and even an isolated storm possible before early afternoon, though the Euro thinks that rain sticks around a lot longer and heavier than the American model does, so keep the rain jacket within reach through lunch just in case. Once the front clears, expect a genuine flip: north winds usher in cooler, drier air and mostly sunny skies for the afternoon, with a high near 73. Clear skies hold overnight with a cool, comfortable low around 53.

Saturday is the payoff, sunny with a high near 78 and calm winds, easily the better of the two lake days this weekend, with the water sitting at a swimmable 73 and waves staying a foot or less most of the day. If you're headed to the waterfront, today's best window is after the front clears, say 2pm on; Saturday you've got the whole day. Enjoy the stretch, because the AFD is already flagging rain returning by Monday night.
